findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "T3R Components, distribuido por Fundamental Bike" → 3 lines (14 words, 80px); "Componentes y recambios para bicicleta, probados" → 5 lines (8 words, 64px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: Hero headline is 14 words ("T3R Components, distribuido por Fundamental Bike Parts. Dire"). Gallery median is 5.
findings.fix: Say the one thing. Move the rest to the supporting line.

findings.message: 15 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Gama T3R" above "Componentes y recambios para bicicleta, "; "Frenada" above "Discos de freno"; "Frenada" above "Pastillas de freno"; "Contacto" above "Pedales"; "Transmisión" above "Pedalier / BB"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 50 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "The Three Riders · by Fundamental", "Desliza", "Directo de fábrica", "·").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 13 gradient fill(s): div.absolute.inset-0 → radial-gradient(circle at 75% 0%, rgba(196, 160, 114, 0.16), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 34%) | div.absolute.inset-0 → linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(196, 160, 114, 0.14), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 42%) | div.absolute.inset-0 → linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(196, 160, 114, 0.14), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 42%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 6 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.fixed.inset-x-0 1440px | section#productos.bg-white.px-5 1440px | section.relative.overflow-hidden 1440px | footer.bg-[#1A100C].border-t 1440px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 15 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (section #f0ede8).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Herramientas" 2.6:1 needs 4.5:1; "Consulta disponibilidad" 2.6:1 needs 4.5:1; "Frenos" 2.6:1 needs 4.5:1; "Consulta disponibilidad" 2.6:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: 41 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: This page is served by a development server (Vite, webpack or Next in dev mode).
findings.fix: Run the last gate on the production build too (vite build && vite preview, next build && next start, or the built index.html): minifiers and bundlers change the CSS a visitor receives.

findings.message: The margins differ: 0px on the left, 89px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (784px, 64px, 80px, 753px, 1082px, 112px, 421px); the three most used hold only 51% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "T3R Components, distribuido por Fundamental Bike" (screen 3, 100% over a picture); "Mejor precio." (screen 3, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 3 screens in a row: "T3R Components, distribuido por Fundamental Bike Parts. Dire"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.
